titleZh: 早高峰地铁抢座（基线组：仅锁定几何与单动作）
environmentEn: bright miniature subway carriage with smooth flat slate floor (zero raised circular Lego floor studs), teal commuter seat, steel-blue window band, and overhead amber strap handles
environmentZh: 明亮微缩地铁车厢，平整深灰无凸点地板（严禁乐高地面凸粒）、青绿色单人座位、冷蓝车窗带与琥珀色刚性吊环扶手

shots.actionEn: Mo stands on the left while Noob stands on the right near the teal subway seat
shots.actionZh: Mo站在左侧，Noob站在右侧青绿色座位旁
shots.faceEn: Mo switches to shocked ring eyes (O_O); Noob keeps Chill (-_-) decal
shots.faceZh: Mo切换为震惊圆圈眼(O_O)；Noob保持死鱼眼(-_-)
shots.sfx: 地铁行驶低频声 + 清脆叮声
shots.caption: 早高峰最后一个空座！

shots.actionEn: Mo sprints two stiff strides across the aisle toward the teal seat
shots.actionZh: Mo迈开两步僵直方腿冲向青绿色座位
shots.faceEn: grinning 2D decal on Mo; deadpan (-_-) decal on Noob
shots.caption: 冲啊！这把稳了

shots.actionEn: Noob sits on the teal seat in a 90-degree hip pivot as Mo recoils
shots.actionZh: Noob呈90度刚性折弯坐下，Mo后仰
shots.faceEn: deadpan (-_-) on Noob; shocked O_O on Mo
shots.caption: 黄皮新手：丝滑截胡

shots.actionEn: suspended with raised block hand docked beneath the overhead strap, Mo swings 8 degrees beside seated Noob
shots.actionZh: Mo高举平头方手贴合吊环悬空轻摆8度，身旁Noob端坐
shots.faceEn: deadpan horizontal line eyes (-_-) on both Mo and Noob
shots.caption: 喜提早高峰塑料挂件体验卡
